records.text: :tada: New signup: *Silver Works* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to either outreach email ([email:b3db0e16], [email:43d84041]) or tickets filed. Silence plus no setup activity in the first week makes unaided activation in the remaining 8 days unlikely, though a Starter admin can still self-serve.

draft.subject: Getting Silver Works started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Checking in now that you've had Wrenfield for a few days. If you haven't started yet, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
